messages: Nora (Product): quick sync on the Compliance > Data panel mock I uploaded. Main concerns: retention wording (does it communicate irreversibility?), region default order, how we surface KMS/BYOK without exposing ARNs, and any accessible keyboard flows before QA. Eli (Design): thinking about clarity: change preset helper from 'Delete after X days' to 'Permanently delete after X days' and add a short inline hint: '(this cannot be undone)'. Also suggest moving Region selector above Retention so jurisdiction is chosen first. Sam (Frontend): agree on DOM order change moving region above retention will also fix tab order. small implementation notes: retention presets should be buttons with aria-pressed and visible focus (use :focus-visible). For the KMS cell, show masked id like 'Key: ••••abcd1234' and a copy button that reveals full ARN in a gated modal only. Priya (Security): absolutely mask ARNs in lists. Full ARN only on explicit action requiring re-auth and logged in audit. Wording: avoid 'delete' alone use 'permanently deleted' or 'irreversibly removed'. For audit entries, include reason: 'automated retention (policy id X)'. A11yBot: scan snapshot: 1) contrast issue on status chip (fails AA). 2) retention modal missing focus trap. 3) region select missing accessible label for VoiceOver on iOS. See https://a11y.report/scan/1967000000 for details. Eli (Design): microcopy for KMS badge: 'Customer key (BYOK) — managed in your KMS' with tooltip 'Redwood cannot export your key material.' Keep badge compact to avoid clutter. Sam (Frontend): quick SR-ready snippet for masked key + reveal flow: ` Full ARN visible after re-auth and will be logged in audit. ` Reveal action opens modal that requires MFA and shows full ARN with copy button. Priya (Security): log every reveal event with user id, timestamp (UTC), and reason. Also add rate-limiting on reveal to prevent scraping. Nora (Product): action items: Eli to update mock (move region, update copy), Sam to add aria-pressed/focus-visible and gated reveal flow PR, Priya to draft masking + audit logging rules. A11yBot to re-scan after PRs. Please ack and claim. Eli (Design): claiming mock updates. Sam (Frontend): claiming a11y + reveal PR. Priya (Security): claiming masking + audit wording. A11yBot: scheduled re-scan in 48h post-merge. Nora (Product): thanks team I'll consolidate the copy and ping legal for the phrasing sign-off on 'permanently'.
